issues.title: P1-T1 legacy-path check silently passes when V2 yaml is absent
issues.details: The bash -lc 'if rg ... .archon/workflows/defaults/archon-piv-loop-codex-v2.yaml; then exit 1; fi' command exits 0 when the file does not exist (rg exits 2, if-branch is false). This means the verify command is vacuously true before S1 creates the V2 yaml. The plan's own task wording gates S2 after S1, so this is not a freeze blocker.
issues.suggested_fix: Optional: add a file-existence guard (test -f ... || { echo 'V2 yaml not yet created'; exit 0; }) for clarity.
